decisions.statement: The moment a day opened is read from the opening window rather than worked out here.
An instant before its ESO day's recorded opening counts to the day before.
An instant at or after the next day's recorded opening counts to the day after.
Only an opening read from a sleep block moves an instant off its ESO day.
No hour on a clock moves an instant off its ESO day.
Nothing here reads a sleep block.
A window that refuses and a window that falls back to the ESO day are two calls.
A caller counting a figure a day page stores takes the window that refuses.
A day that will not parse answers a window at the epoch to the caller taking the other call.

definition: which day an instant falls in, counted from the moment Alan's day opens
